newsitem.title: UK: UK's Unipart says sales reached 1 bln stg in 1996.
newsitem.headline: UK's Unipart says sales reached 1 bln stg in 1996.

text.p: The Unipart Group of Companies, one of Europe's largest independent suppliers of automotive parts and accessories, said on Thursday that 1996 sales had climbed above the one billion stg mark.

Turnover in the year to December 31 was 1.01 billion stg versus 864 million in 1995, while pre-tax profit rose more than five percent to 33.0 million from 31.5 million. Total dividends increased to 7.1 million stg from 6.5 million in 1995.

Group activity expanded in 1996 through the setting up of five joint venture companies, new parts logistics contracts and export growth in Europe, including the expansion of its mobile communications division, said chief executive John Neil.
The group, which gained independence via a management buy-out in 1987, continued to pursue a strategy providing for growth and development, he said in a statement.

"Developing these new growth businesses will require a significant level of investment. The group is fully prepared for this and recognises it will impact on our returns in 1997," said Neil. "We are confident that these carefully planned investments are essential for value creation and will provide for success into the next century".
